data.exact_reserve_text: The segment reported a small profit for the year, with current year losses in Marine Hull and Marine Energy being offset by prior year reserve releases due to favourable claims experience. The segment showed a sizable loss as a result of further deterioration in the Professional Indemnity business line and a review of our Actuarial assumptions in Financial Institutions. This segment suffered from deterioration on prior year losses.
data.standardized_narrative: Reserve movements in 2018 were mixed. The Marine and Energy portfolios experienced favourable prior-year reserve releases driven by improved claims experience, partially offsetting current year losses. Offsetting these favourable movements, the Professional Indemnity / Financial & Professional Lines portfolios deteriorated (including an actuarial assumptions review), and the Reinsurance segment experienced adverse prior-year development. No single gross prior-year reserve movement amount is explicitly stated in the financial statements' movement notes, so a quantitative gross PYD figure could not be extracted from the available tables.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year reserve releases due to favourable claims experience
further deterioration in the Professional Indemnity business line
review of our Actuarial assumptions in Financial Institutions
suffered from deterioration on prior year losses

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (PYD) amount is stated in the movement note that isolates prior year development. The notes and managing agent narrative describe both favourable prior-year releases (Marine/Energy) and adverse prior-year deterioration (Professional Indemnity, Reinsurance) but only total gross 'change in claims outstanding' (which includes current year movements) is tabulated. A gross PYD number could not be unambiguously extracted; a gross claims development triangle is present (see _claims_triangle) and could be used as a last-resort calculation, but the report does not present an explicit gross 'movement in prior years' line. Consequently prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null and the direction is reported as 'mixed'.
